collection: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo 64, 1998)
contentType: Fan-made MIDI arrangements / sequences; not official soundtrack audio recordings.
originalGameAndMusicRights: Nintendo and the respective rights holders. Fan arrangement credits are listed separately.

archivePolicy.observedStatement: Zelda Dungeon says its media can be redistributed under its fair-use assumption and disclaims ownership of that media.
archivePolicy.limits: This archive statement is not an independently verified license from Nintendo or the sequencers. These files are not asserted to be public domain, royalty-free, Creative Commons, or official Nintendo releases. The GFDL statement on that page concerns text; it is not applied to the MIDI files.
archivePolicy.hosting: Downloaded from Zelda Dungeon and hosted locally; no runtime hotlinks to either archive.

validation.method: Parsed the full Standard MIDI File structure: MThd/MTrk headers, delta times, channel events, tempo events and End-of-Track events. Checked complete file boundaries and nonzero note-on events. SHA-256 fingerprints are recorded for each unchanged download.
validation.durationMethod: Duration calculated from MIDI ticks and tempo events. Final audible release tails depend on the synthesizer.
validation.listeningStatus: Structural validation only in this asset-gathering step; browser playback validation belongs to the site integration.

files.title: Title Theme
files.attributionEvidence: No arranger named in the file or source table. The matching VGMusic entry names Sirius as uploader only; uploader is not assumed to be arranger.

files.attributionEvidence: Sequencer credited by the VGMusic entry with the identical MD5.

files.title: Kakariko Village
files.attributionEvidence: Sequencer credited by the VGMusic entry with the identical MD5; file also names Koji Kondo as composer.

files.title: Windmill Hut (Song of Storms)
files.attributionEvidence: Embedded MIDI text credits the arrangement to Talek Julian / Talek R Julian.

files.title: Meet Zelda Again
files.attributionEvidence: Embedded MIDI text credits Aivi (Sirius) for sequencing and arrangement, and Koji Kondo for the original. This is Adult Zelda's Theme, not relabeled as the Zelda's Lullaby track.

files.title: Zora's Domain
files.attributionEvidence: Embedded MIDI text credits Shawn Overn, copyright 1999. The archive directory lists this Ocarina of Time variant as Zoras-Domain-1.mid.
